text:
Maya: handing over now - quick context: we've been seeing a ~20m spike of 504/5xx on /v1/generate from us-west. latency up for some customers, pager fired (prod-inference-high-5xx).
OncallBot: Pager: prod-inference-high-5xx | Severity: P2 | Affected: inference-prod-us-west | Link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/1789456123
Arjun: started mitigation about 10m ago. Rolled routing to fallback model variant (gpt-small-quant-usw) for bursty keys per runbook. Also raised replica count on the GPU pool. Seeing reduced tail latency for some requests but 504s still ~3-4% for a subset of customers.
Maya: ok I can take primary from here. I'll be driving the mitigation. Who wants comms (customer updates / status page)?
Sam: I can own comms. I'll draft a short status note and post to #status and status.redwood.ai. I'll DM affected CSMs for any high-touch customers.
Priya: I'm on call but in transit for next 2h. I can be secondary on pager and reachable by phone. Any planned rollback or config change I should be aware of?
Arjun: no full rollback yet. Actions taken:
1) routing -> fallback model
2) +2 replicas to inference-prod-us-west
3) restarted model-serving pods with new kernel flags (see logs). Left commands in runbook notes:
```
# scale up replicas
kubectl scale deploy inference-prod --replicas=8 -n prod-us-west
# restart with kernel flag
kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-prod -n prod-us-west
```
Arjun: also toggled prefix caching off briefly to reduce KV pressure (runbook section cache-throttling)
Maya: thanks. I'll validate traffic shift and monitor dashboards: tokens/sec, 5xx rate, p95 latency, inflight queue depth. If 5xx remains >1% for 10m we'll trigger failover to dedicated-pool-usw.
Sam: posted initial status: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1789456123 - note: Partial degradation for inference endpoints in us-west; mitigation in progress. Will update every 10 minutes or on owner update. :clock10:
DeployBot: Deploy connected: last rollout 2026-02-18T22:11Z by ci-bot - no ongoing deploys reported.
Priya: question: any impact to embeddings or rerank endpoints, or only /v1/generate?
Arjun: looks isolated to generation paths - embeddings ok.
Maya: plan summary: I am primary (driver) until handoff at 18:00 UTC; Sam is comms owner; Priya is secondary/backup for escalation. Arjun to stay on thread as SME for routing and kernel flags. If we need capacity beyond replica bump we'll failover traffic to dedicated-pool-usw (pre-approved by infra).
Sam: will do customer comms and notify account teams for top-10 affected customers. Draft saved here: https://docs.internal.redwood/status-drafts/1789456123
Arjun: troubleshooting note - if errors persist check GPU memory pressure and kernel selection logs at /var/log/inference/kernel-select.log. Also check cache eviction rates: redis keys evicted/sec.
Maya: taking control. I'll post periodic updates every 10m. Current metrics: 5xx now 2.1% (was 4.8%), p95 latency down 15%. Will escalate to failover if >1% after next window.
Sam: acknowledged. I set a recurring reminder to update status every 10 minutes.
Maya: final for now - continuing to watch. If anyone sees any customer DMs or high-severity alerts, ping me directly.
OncallBot: Ownership assigned - primary: Maya | comms: Sam | secondary: Priya | sm-expert: Arjun. Reminder: escalate to platform-oncall if we hit failover condition.
